integrity: Symbolic all-directive proof with explicit phase and recurrence lemmas; executable finite checks are supplementary rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-positive-length formula for six Stewart patterns; not asserted for other Toeplitz families, nor for individual Parikh-vector occurrence frequencies. An unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Balanced-ternary digit weight gives the exact abelian complexity of every Stewart word
